map.由压差与截面积求体积流量: Find the Volume Flow Rate from the Pressure Difference and Cross-sectional Area
map.输入入口/喉部面积 A1、A2 与压差 ΔP、密度 ρ，求流量。: Enter the inlet and throat areas A1 and A2, the pressure difference ΔP and the density ρ to find the flow rate.
map.由伯努利+连续性推导。: Derived from Bernoulli together with continuity.
map.由压差测流量: Measuring flow from a pressure difference
map.Q = A2·√(2·Δp/(rho·(1−(A2/A1)²)))。喉部缩径产生: Q = A2·√(2·Δp/(rho·(1−(A2/A1)²))). The throat constriction creates a pressure difference that is converted into flow, and this simplified form omits the discharge coefficient.
map.无活动件、压损小，靠压差测量流量。: It has no moving parts and a small pressure loss, measuring flow through the pressure difference.
